name: risen_reef_land_on_top_declined_goes_to_hand
notes: Printed: '... you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.' The top card is a Forest and seat 0 declines: the Forest goes to seat 0's hand (hand 1), not the battlefield, and the card below it stays on top of the library.
